title: Fractions Basics
concept: A fraction represents part of a whole. Use a common denominator before adding or subtracting fractions.

title: Linear Equations
concept: Solve linear equations by isolating the variable using inverse operations on both sides.

title: Probability Fundamentals
concept: Probability is favorable outcomes divided by total outcomes, with values between 0 and 1.

title: Area and Units
concept: Area measures surface size. For rectangles, area equals length multiplied by width, with squared units.

title: Ratio and Proportion
concept: A ratio compares two quantities. Proportions are equations showing two ratios are equal.
